Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:05 PM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue–Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Tickets: adults ₹20 foreign nationals ₹500 and students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. It opens next on Wed 28 Oct, 10:00 AM. The site's notice says the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation. That notice is dated 29 May 2023, so it may be out of date.
